results.evidence: `onClick={() => { duplicateInsight(insight as InsightModel, true); setScenePanelOpen(false) }}` closes the panel unconditionally, not specifically when displayed as an overlay. It does close the panel in the overlay case, so the narrow-screen behaviour is covered, but it is not conditioned on overlay mode. Closing happens at click time, not as part of the duplication flow completing; the panel does close, so the new insight is visible. Leaning met for the overlay case, but the unconditional close conflicts with c3.
The patch leaves `duplicateInsight(insight, true)` in place and only adds `setScenePanelOpen(false)` after it. The redirect and success reporting stay in the logic, so they are not suppressed.
`setScenePanelOpen(false)` is called unconditionally in the onClick handler. There is no check on overlay vs docked presentation, so a docked wide-screen panel would also be closed.

The push in InsightPanelActions is unchanged: `push(urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!))`. The short id is not carried in the URL. The patch instead fetches it asynchronously with `insightsApi.getByNumericId` on mount, which does not satisfy 'carries the short identifier along with the numeric transfer identifier'.

`sourceResourceUrl` for 'Insight' returns `urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId)` when the short id is available. The short id is loaded from the API by numeric id in `sourceInsightShortId`, so Back resolves to the short-id view URL once it loads.
`return insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()` falls back to the insights list when there is no short id.
The Dashboard and Survey cases still return `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `urls.survey(resourceId)`. The loader returns null for non-Insight kinds, and no transfer URL parameter is added.

The card has `className="p-6 @container"`. The inner div has `flex flex-col @sm:flex-row`, and the illustration is wrapped as `<div className="hidden @sm:block shrink-0">`. Below @sm the illustration is hidden and the content stacks vertically.

result:
I made all three changes, but none of them has been run, type-checked or looked at in a browser.

1. **Duplicate closes the sidebar.** In `InsightPanelActions.tsx`, clicking Duplicate now also closes the scene panel, so the new copy is visible. It closes when you click, not when the copy finishes, so a failed duplicate also closes the panel.

2. **Transfer page Back link.** The Back link was passing the numeric ID to `urls.insightView`, which expects a short ID. `resourceTransferLogic.ts` now looks up the insight's short ID when the page loads, and `ResourceTransfer.tsx` uses it for the link. I used `urls.insightView`, the same link the rest of the app uses. If the lookup hasn't returned yet, or fails, Back goes to the saved insights list instead. That fallback is my choice, so say if you'd prefer something else.

3. **Narrow subscriptions modal.** The empty-state card in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx` is now a container-query container. Below the `@sm` width the illustration is hidden and the icon and text stack vertically, and at `@sm` and above the illustration sits beside the text as before.

I edited the hand-written kea type declarations in `resourceTransferLogic.ts` (the "Generated by kea-typegen" blocks) by hand instead of regenerating them. I added no tests.
